messages:
maria: Observed a regression on the large-TP+PP runs after yesterday's kernel routing change — PP-stage bubble latency spikes when microbatch size > 4. flamegraphs show longer all-reduce tail.

dylan: Ack. Which kernel change landed? IIRC it switched to the new fused-gemm path for int8.

maria: Right — commit 9f3a5d switched kernel selector to prefer fused-gemm for short seq. Perf numbers looked fine single-GPU but multi-GPU shows extra syncs.

hao: Can you paste the profiler snapshot? also which schedule — we're on 1f1b strict (one-forward-one-back) with overlap enabled.

maria: Paste from perf-bot: 
```
flame: /perf/2718002400/flame.svg
KV-cache-miss-rate: 12%
Allreduce-time p99: 18.6ms (prev 9.8ms)
Comm/compute overlap: decreased ~35%
```

ravi: KV-cache miss rate 12% is interesting — maybe fused kernel changes cache footprint (KV alignment) causing extra spill or unaligned loads.

dylan: Also check microbatch grouping. If microbatch > 4, the per-step matmuls change shape distribution and can flip kernel choice back to slower path at runtime.

maria: I ran an experiment toggling kernel_selector.force_old_path=true in runtime config; allreduce p99 dropped back to ~10ms and bubble latency normalized.

hao: That suggests the selector heuristics are oscillating based on sequence/microbatch distribution. Prob cause: shape-driven kernel scoring + global preference for fused-gemm which triggers an extra synchronization for certain layouts.

dylan: Possible fix: add a TP-aware penalty to kernel score when used inside pipeline stage boundaries, or prefer kernels that stream NVSHMEM-friendly buffers (avoid host staging).

ravi: Quick checklist:
- reproduce with small script (maria has run)
- capture NCCL traces + kernel launch timestamps
- try force_old_path toggle
- collect KV cache hit/miss heatmap per step

maria: I'm uploading nccl trace: /artifacts/2718002400/nccl_trace.log and a small reproducer: gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/abc123

perf-bot: CI perf run 2718002410 completed — throughput -6.2%, latency +22% on multi-gpu 8xA100.

ci-bot: Added perf regression ticket: RN-4572 and annotated with artifacts.

hao: For immediate mitigation, let's default microbatch cap to 4 for PP runs and disable fused-gemm by default for pipeline-enabled configs. We'll add a rollout flag.

dylan: Also will add metric to runtime: kernel-switch-count per-epoch and a KV-cache occupancy sampler (10s window) so we can correlate.

ravi: For the longer term we should: (1) update kernel scoring to penalize kernel choices that increase inter-node communication, (2) test with NCCL async allreduce, (3) add a KB test that exercises microbatch distribution.

maria: Plan sounds good. I'll open a PR with the microbatch cap toggle + force_old_path flag defaulting for PP; will attach reproducer and perf runs. @dylan please add the kernel-switch-count metric.

dylan: On it. I'll also sketch a patch that avoids swapping kernel mid-session unless the score delta > 1.5x.

maria: Thanks. Quick note — we should include an e2e run with kv-cache prefill to validate it's not just cold-start misses.

ravi: Could be a compound effect: KV-prefill reduces misses and keeps kernel working set consistent. schedule changes + kernel flip + KV spills = bubble.

maria: I'll schedule a 1h blameless triage after lunch to review traces and decide rollout. tl;dr: suspected kernel selector heuristic causing suboptimal choice in PP leading to higher all-reduce tail and reduced comm/compute overlap; mitigation = cap microbatch + conservative kernel selection + KV-prefill test. :white_check_mark:

dylan: 👍

hao: 👍

perf-bot: Next steps checklist created: /tasks/RN-4572/checklist
